scripts.dev: npm run dev:ensure-assets && npm run dev:clean-ports && vite
scripts.dev:local-api: npm run dev:ensure-assets && npm run dev:clean-ports && npm run db:migrate && concurrently -n web,api "VITE_USE_LOCAL_API=1 vite" "wrangler dev"
scripts.dev:clean-ports: for p in 8787 9024 9025; do lsof -nP -iTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; done
scripts.dev:worker: npm run dev:ensure-assets && npm run db:migrate && wrangler dev
scripts.seed: node scripts/seed-d1.mjs && wrangler d1 execute checkmark-fitness --remote --file=seed-generated.sql
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build:prod && wrangler deploy && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name mxn-checkmark-fitness --branch main --commit-dirty=true
